entry.name: sprintf
entry.digest: Format a message of words and numbers
entry.description: Uses the common C-language "printf" function inside Max. You can combine symbols, organize lists of numbers, or format messages or menu items. For complete documentation, refer to a standard C library reference manual.

arguments.name: symout
arguments.description: If the first argument is the word, theobject outputs the string it generates as a single symbol. Otherwise the output is a list of symbols and/or numbers. The worditself is not included in the output of sprintf.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: The arguments form a message to be sent out, in a format resembling the C programming language. The arguments may be words, numbers, or changeable arguments for incoming symbols ((), floats (), and ints that are to be formatted as ASCII characters (). The number of inlets is determined by the number of changeable arguments, with each inlet corresponding to a changeable argument, in order.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Performs the same function as a.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Output using the most recent values
messages.description: In left inlet: Formats the message using the values currently stored.Any of the above messages in the left inlet will format the message and send it out. If no value has been received for a changeable number argument (or), 0 will be substituted for that argument. If no value has been received for aorargument, that argument will be left blank.

messages.name: float
messages.description: May be received in any inlet that corresponds to aargument. The number will be stored in place of that argument.

messages.name: int
messages.description: May be received in any inlet that corresponds to aorargument. The number will be stored in place of that argument. Aargument will convert the int to its ASCII character equivalent.

messages.name: list
messages.description: In left inlet: Each item in the list is treated as if it had been received in a separate inlet, up to the number of inlets.

messages.name: symbol
messages.description: May be received in any inlet that corresponds to aargument. The symbol will be stored in place of that argument.
